newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DST Systems Q4 EPS lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DST Systems Q4 EPS lowered.

text.p: -- Gruntal Investment Research Inc said Thursday it tempered its estimate for DST Systems Inc's fourth quarter earnings per share to between $0.23 and $0.24 from $0.25.

-- Gruntal said it does not appear likely that DST will post $1.00 EPS in 1996 because of continued costly overseas development outlays that Gruntal expects will eventually pay off. Gruntal said 1996 EPS should land between $0.95 to $1.00.
-- DST is still rated outperform, Gruntal said.
-- Gruntal also lowered its earnings estimate for 1997 to $1.15 per share from $1.20.
-- DST stock was unchanged Thursday at 31-7/8.
